script: Sarasota Paradise has folded. That's according to a Backheeled report, citing unnamed sources. The club played one season as a pro team in USL League One, and finished eleventh. If it's true, that's the fourth League One club gone this year. Tormenta shut down before the season. Westchester and Corpus Christi dropped out. And the club's site still sells 2027 season tickets. What should the league change? Tell us in the comments.
caption:
Sarasota Paradise has folded, according to a Backheeled report citing unnamed sources. 🚨

The Florida club played one season in USL League One (2026) and finished 11th. The club and USL have not commented, and the club site still lists 2027 season tickets.

If the report holds, it is the fourth League One club gone this year: South Georgia Tormenta shut down before the season, and Westchester SC and Corpus Christi dropped out.

What should the league change so this stops happening? Tell us in the comments 👇

Source: Backheeled (Nov 12, 2026); Sarasota Paradise club site. Unconfirmed report; we will update if the club or USL comments. Crest as listed in the Cancha directory; no affiliation implied.
